title: TextOCVP: Text-Conditioned Object-Centric Video Generation
description: Introducing an object-centric model for image-to-video generation guided by textual descriptions.
body: We propose TextOCVP, an object-centric model for image-to-video generation guided by textual descriptions.

TextOCVP jointly models object dynamics and interactions while incorporating textual guidance, leading to accurate and controllable predictions. Its structured latent space gives greater control over the prediction process while improving interpretability.
